description: Recent smoke failures on registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, and signal_analyser.py all show identical traceback: 'File "<string>", line 10, in <module> File "<frozen importlib'. This indicates an import chain failure at line 10 of some module these files try to import. Create a diagnostic that: (1) parses the smoke failure log to extract the common import path, (2) checks which shared dependency is causing the failure, (3) reports the specific import statement that fails. Output a JSON diagnostic report. Do NOT propose a fix file — that is the meta-task that spec forbids. This diagnostic enables a human to understand what rebuild directive to issue.
